title: The Only Man With No Countdown

scenes.image: Vertical shot of a grey-bearded older man in a dark coat standing in a rainy crowded city street at night, everyone around him has a glowing red countdown above their head, he has none, he looks up.
lines: [mysterious] Every person on Earth woke up with a number above their head. Their countdown.
scenes.motion: The crowd moves around the still older man as he slowly lifts his gaze, rain falling through red glow.

scenes.image: Grainy security camera footage of a crowded Washington D.C. train station, glowing numbers above everyone.
lines: Three days later, this video went viral. A train station in Washington, D.C. Thousands of people. Thousands of numbers.

scenes.image: Security-camera view of the older man in a dark coat standing still in a moving crowd, no number above him.
Close-up of the older man looking straight into the security camera with a faint smile.
lines: No countdown. He stops. He turns to the camera. And he smiles.
[calm] You're all measuring the wrong thing.

scenes.image: A worn leather notebook on a metal table, its first page dated twenty years ago.
lines: His name is Thomas Reed. A math professor who vanished twenty years ago. And he has a notebook... dated twenty years before the numbers appeared.

scenes.image: Dr. Brooks across a metal table from the older man, stunned.
lines: [quietly] Because I've seen the numbers before.

scenes.image: Close-up of the older man's face under red light, no number above him, enigmatic.
lines: So why doesn't he have one?
